page_title: INT 5-2 ROM | Inter v AS Roma 05/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Inter exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
90+1' Simone Sozza interrupts the game. One of the players from AS Roma won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
88' AS Roma keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
86' Simone Sozza blows for a foul after Federico Dimarco (Inter) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. AS Roma win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
85' AS Roma force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
84' A long pass, executed by Federico Dimarco (Inter), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
83' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Zeki Celik (AS Roma).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mario Hermoso departs the field of play to be replaced by Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma).
81' Inter force a corner. They send men into the box.
80' Mile Svilar pulls off a great save to deny Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
78' The ball is cleared after Denzel Dumfries (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
77' What a huge chance for Denzel Dumfries (Inter). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
76' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) sends a chip pass into the box, but Yann Sommer is quickest to intercept the ball.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is coming onto the pitch as Piotr Zielinski cannot continue after picking up an injury.
75' Flag up against Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
73' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
72' The ball goes out for a corner. Inter can continue in their attacking effort.
70' 5 - 2 Goal! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 5:2.
69' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
67' Substitution. Marcus Thuram makes way for Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
66' Cristian Chivu has decided to make a change. Petar Sucic (Inter) replaces Hakan Calhanoglu.
64' Substitution. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) has come on for Matias Soule.
63' 5 - 1 Goal! Nicolo Barella (Inter) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 5:1.
62' Matias Soule (AS Roma) tries to find Donyell Malen, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
60' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
58' We are about to witness a substitution. Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) is replacing Devyne Rensch.
58' Cristian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) replacing Lautaro Martinez.
58' The manager makes a subsitution with Matteo Darmian (Inter) coming on for Alessandro Bastoni.

55' 4 - 1 Marcus Thuram (Inter) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Hakan Calhanoglu. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 4:1.
55' Corner kick. Inter will have an opportunity.
54' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

52' 3 - 1 Goal! Marcus Thuram displays great vision and sends a pass to Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 3:1.
51' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
49' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
48' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) makes a strong challenge and Simone Sozza blows for a foul.
46' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is being substituted because of an injury. Gian Piero Gasperini sends Daniele Ghilardi on the pitch.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' 2 - 1 Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) scores one of the best goals in his career. His rocket of a shot from distance goes straight into the top left corner. They will be showing this on every football show for some time to come.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Mile Svilar comes off his line to gather the ball.
42' The game is interrupted as Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is flagged offside.
40' 1 - 1 Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) latches on to a stunning cross and plants a header past the goalkeeper.
40' AS Roma win a corner.
39' AS Roma have a corner.
37' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) looks to pass after collecting a rebound, but a lack of options forces him to shoot from distance and it's easily blocked by an opponent.
36' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) attempts to find Lautaro Martinez, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
35' A cross into the box from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared.
33' Good team movement sets up Piotr Zielinski (Inter) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
32' The AS Roma players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
29' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) tries to find Hakan Calhanoglu, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
27' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mile Svilar, who smothers the ball.
27' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Inter.
27' Federico Dimarco (Inter) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Inter will take a corner kick.
26' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
25' What an opportunity! Donyell Malen (AS Roma) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post!
24' The referee signals a corner kick to AS Roma.

24' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the right post, but Yann Sommer pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
23' Simone Sozza has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alessandro Bastoni (Inter).
22' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Devyne Rensch, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
20' The free kick is taken by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), but ball is cleared.
20' Poor challenge! Manuel Akanji (Inter) is penalised for tripping and Simone Sozza blows his whistle. Free kick. AS Roma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
19' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
15' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
14' The linesman points to the corner flag, Inter are going to take it.

13' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Mile Svilar shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The linesman makes the right call and Inter will have a corner.
12' The AS Roma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
11' A crossfield pass from Zeki Celik (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates.
10' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Great teamplay by Inter as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
6' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the left side of the target, but Mile Svilar keeps it out with an amazing save.
4' The referee blows his whistle as Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) was too aggressive in his challenge.
3' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) tackles a bit over-zealously and Simone Sozza blows for a foul.
1' 1 - 0 Lautaro Martinez (Inter) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball into the top right corner.
1' Neat passing move from Inter in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Simone Sozza.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
